summary: Added a 'Print QR sheet' button to the Access Codes admin page next to the existing create/bulk controls. It calls window.print() to render a print-only QR grid of the currently-filtered codes. Added the qrcode.react dependency, a print-only stylesheet in index.css that hides the app chrome and renders a high-contrast (black-on-white) grid, and EN/HE i18n keys under the codes.* namespace.
appImpact: Organizers on the Access Codes page can now click 'Print QR sheet' and the browser print dialog produces a clean multi-code-per-page sheet of scannable QR codes (one per access code) with the code text and label/game beneath each — respecting the active all/unused/used/revoked filter.
userImpactSummary: Organizers can print a physical hand-out of scannable access-code QR codes to distribute to teams on event day.
nowLive: A printable QR-code sheet for access codes is now available in the admin app; previously the codes existed only as an on-screen table.
playerVisibleChange: An admin sees a new 'Print QR sheet' button on the Access Codes page; clicking it opens a print preview showing a grid of QR codes (encoding each access code string) with the code and its label/game, ready to print.
selfCheck: Ran `npx tsc --noEmit` in apps/admin — passes with no errors. QRCodeSVG is imported from qrcode.react (v4 named export). The print sheet uses .print-sheet (display:none on screen) and an @media print block that hides body chrome via visibility and reveals only the sheet, so window.print() yields a clean sheet. Button is disabled when no codes are visible.
acceptanceMet: Print QR sheet button added near create/bulk controls on the Access Codes page
Clicking it triggers window.print() over a print-optimized view of the currently-filtered codes (respects active filter via the shared `visible` memo)
Each cell renders a scannable QR encoding the code string, the code text below, and label/game when present
Print-only @media print stylesheet hides nav/header chrome and lays out a 3-per-row grid (page-break-inside avoided) for multiple codes per page
EN and HE strings wired through codes.printSheet / codes.printHeading; print sheet uses logical inset properties for RTL safety
No changes to create/bulk/revoke/table logic — addition is purely additive
notes: Added qrcode.react@^4.2.0 (pure JS, no native deps) to apps/admin and updated package-lock.json via npm install. QR encodes the raw access-code string only; mobile scanning wiring was intentionally left out of scope. Print layout fixed at 3 columns; could be made configurable later if organizers want larger/smaller cells.
